answer: A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The jetty counter is kept in summit and jade shows each reset. An attacker thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4503 identities would post 3994 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
